verdict.rationale: Governance and stewardship are a fair question for any framework, but the evidence pack has no statement on whether Proa is run by a foundation or a single company, and nothing on its license, governance model, or continuity commitments. The only hint is that the repository sits under a GitHub organization named "Proa-Labs", which is an inference rather than documented governance disclosure.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether the framework is governed by a foundation or a single company, so I can assess long-term continuity and lock-in risk
